title: Valley stories
alt: Snowy Himalayan peaks above a green Kashmir valley
description: Houseboat mornings, mountain roads, and valley views that make the journey feel as lovely as the destination.
fullDescription: This is a gentle Kashmir introduction shaped around Srinagar's waters, Gulmarg's high views, and Pahalgam's quieter river valleys. Daily plans stay flexible around weather and road conditions.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Srinagar
itinerary.text: Arrive and settle into your stay, with time for a calm evening by the water.

itinerary.title: A slower lake day
itinerary.text: Take a shikara ride and explore gardens or old Srinagar neighbourhoods.

itinerary.title: Up to Gulmarg
itinerary.text: Head into the hills for open views and seasonal activities based on local conditions.

itinerary.title: Follow the river
itinerary.text: Travel towards Pahalgam and enjoy the changing landscape along the way.

itinerary.title: Valley morning
itinerary.text: Keep the day easy with a local walk, scenic stops, and time to simply take it in.
